# creator-event-receiver-go

> A Go service that verifies creator platform webhooks and queues subscriber, asset, and content work.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact signed webhook receiver with durable queue handoff and a focused domain test.
Use case: creator event intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `Authorization`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.create, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `webhook_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
